item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Project Nova
item.description:
Project Nova is a private preview for independent verification of specific claims without exposing underlying data. It is aimed at regulated industries that need to establish trust while keeping confidential information protected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: New API endpoint provides privacy-safe star history data
item.description:
GitHub added a new REST API endpoint for repository star history that lets users track star growth over time without exposing individual stargazer identities. This follows earlier restrictions on stargazer listing endpoints to admins and collaborators.

  • Source: GitHub
